opening.argument: The presentation ties participation by existing and new members to expected investment returns, urging attendees to “Excite people about the coin” and “Use the coin.” It invites further purchases and claims, “You can convert this investment anytime to cash,” while describing account-based gold redemption, commissions, exchange functions, KYC, and cards. Yet the speaker acknowledges that transactions occurred only on the internal exchange and treats outside listings as a future effort. These promotional investment and appreciation claims are therefore presented alongside mechanisms for purchase, redemption, and commissions, even though actual returns, funding, redemption, commission terms, and successful cash conversion are not established.
